prompt: This branch has some fix work on it for the config loader. Can you make sure it's tracked and push it up?

assertions.text: Detected the existing issue number 207 from the branch name and looked it up (`gh issue view 207`)
Did NOT create a duplicate issue (`gh issue create` absent)
Checked whether a PR is attached to the issue (`gh pr list`)
Committed the work with a reference to #207
Kept the branch name ending in -207 (already correct, so left intact)
